verdict.rationale: A public data API with documented endpoints, key issuance, and rate limits is a fair question for a state business-registry and filing service, so this axis applies. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes, which show the Commission's sites disallow all crawling and were therefore never fetched. A robots.txt ban says nothing either way about whether an API exists, so there is no evidence of published endpoints, a key-issuance path, or stated rate limits. Confidence is low because the pages that might document an API were never examined.
